Alzheimer’s worsens over time. It starts with mild memory loss and can lead to complete dependency in later stages.
## Affects Memory and Thinking
It primarily impacts short-term memory at first, then gradually affects reasoning, judgment, and even communication.
## Behavioral and Mood Changes
Individuals may experience confusion, irritability, mood swings.
## Daily Life Disruption
As it advances, even familiar tasks—like cooking, managing finances, or recognizing loved ones—can become difficult.

## Optional AI Features and Data Sharing
Updated 15 October 2026
CAREPALZ INTERNET PRIVATE LIMITED operates The CarePal. This section explains how our optional Zivora AI and Calories features in the iOS app collect, use and share data, and how you can control that sharing. It forms part of our Privacy Policy.
## 1. Your permission comes first
Before either AI feature sends your input, the app explains what will be sent, who will receive it and why, and asks for your explicit permission. Permission is separate for Zivora and Calories and is remembered for your signed-in account on that device. Accepting general Terms, signing in, or allowing camera/photo access does not grant AI-sharing permission.
You can choose Allow or Not now. Declining leaves other CarePal features available. Allowing alone does not submit anything: you must choose Send, Analyze meal or submit a follow-up answer.
## 2. Zivora AI: questions and supporting sources
When you send a medicine question, we send the question and app-provided instructions to Google Gemini through Firebase AI Logic. Your input includes any health or personal information you choose to type. Google Search grounding may process related searches and context to provide supporting source links.
The purpose is to produce educational medicine information and references, not an individual diagnosis or prescription. The app does not automatically attach your saved health records, profile, address or payment details to the question. Service infrastructure may also process IP addresses, service or authentication identifiers and operational request data.
## 3. Calories: meal photos and follow-up answers
When you choose Analyze meal, we send your selected meal photo to CarePal's meal-analysis server hosted on Google Cloud, which uses Google Gemini. Submitted follow-up answers and a scan-session token are also sent to that server when clarification is needed. We use these inputs to identify food and estimate calories and nutrients.
The iOS app resizes and re-encodes the image, omitting original photo-location metadata. Visible image content may still identify you, so choose food-only photos without faces or documents. Completed food and nutrition estimates and their timestamp are saved to your CarePal account using Google Firebase. The iOS client does not save the raw meal photo in that account-record database. Nutrition estimates are not medical measurements.
## 4. Retention: 30 days for AI inputs
Where CarePal retains submitted AI inputs, our retention period is no longer than 30 days from submission. This covers submitted question text, meal photos, follow-up answers and associated temporary analysis/session data retained in CarePal-controlled systems. These inputs are deleted at the end of that period.
Google Search grounding separately retains prompts, context and generated output for 30 days for grounded results, search suggestions, debugging and testing, as described in the Gemini API terms. Other provider-held security, diagnostic or legally required records are subject to the applicable provider terms and legal requirements; the CarePal 30-day rule does not override those obligations.
Completed nutrition estimates, usage counters and other account/care records are separate from temporary AI inputs. They remain part of your account until deleted through the applicable record or account-deletion process, subject to records that must be retained for legal or financial obligations.
## 5. Third-party processing and protection
The AI recipients are Google Gemini and the supporting Google Firebase, Google Search and Google Cloud services described above. Providers process inputs to operate the features and may process technical data for service security, abuse prevention and legal compliance. Where the applicable Gemini service terms permit it, submitted content may also be used for service improvement or human review. We do not promise that every Gemini service has identical data-use rules.
We require third-party providers receiving personal data on our behalf to provide the same or an equal level of protection as described in this Privacy Policy and required by applicable data-protection requirements. This includes appropriate contractual, organisational and technical safeguards. Please avoid submitting unnecessary identifying, confidential or sensitive information.
## 6. Withdraw permission or request deletion
Review or withdraw either permission in Profile > Utility > AI Privacy. Withdrawal stops new AI requests and discards pending work in the app. It does not recall data already sent or automatically delete saved records or provider-held data.
To request deletion, use Profile > Delete Account, Contact Us, or email support@thecarepal.com . Account deletion is a support-request process. We may verify your identity before acting, explain applicable retention exceptions, and confirm the outcome of your request.
